This has been demonstrated by examining the brains of London Taxi drivers, who must memorise every street in London, together with every public building, church, mosque, synagogue, hospital etc. This is known as "The Knowledge" and takes years to learn before the driver is awarded his Green Badge.

Refresh your knowledge from time to time, as capitals sometimes move or are renamed. Nigeria moved its capital from Lagos to Abuja, and Brazil moved its own from Rio to Brasilia.
